emotionalTarget: The homeowner is anxious about cost and competence. The hero must immediately communicate that this company is honest, capable, and will not waste their time or money.

subjectOptions.description: A uniformed HVAC technician working on equipment at a residential home. Clean uniform, visible name badge, professional posture.
A family relaxed at home in comfortable temperature. Natural expressions, not staged. Living room or kitchen setting.
A technician explaining something to a homeowner. Both standing near equipment. Technician pointing or showing clipboard. Trust and transparency moment.

lighting.direction: Side or three-quarter front lighting. No harsh overhead.
lighting.notes: Warm but not yellow. Clean and real. Avoid stock-photo fluorescent look.

colorTones.accents: Orange highlights on uniform logo, equipment, or CTA overlay
colorTones.avoid: Oversaturated colors, neon, cold blue tones

composition.layout: Subject on one side, text overlay space on the other. 60/40 or 50/50 split.
composition.focusPoint: Subject's face or hands at work. Eyes should be visible when possible.
composition.depth: Shallow depth of field on background. Subject sharp.
composition.overlay: Dark gradient from text side (navy at 60-70% opacity) fading to transparent over the image.

regionDefaults.us-south: Outdoor AC unit visible. Green lawn. Warm weather implied.
regionDefaults.us-north: Furnace or indoor setting. Winter coat on hook in background.
regionDefaults.us-general: Neutral residential exterior or interior. No extreme weather cues.
